title: Good Size
text: Good Size. While I am not pleased with how I'm using this bathroom counter organizer, I am more than satisfied with it. I just quickly put some products and tools in it when I brought it to the room. I'm just not sure that I am  getting the maximum use of it. The storage piece is a good size and can accommodate many items. It has a sturdy feel to it. It definitely helps to keep the counter neat.

product_metadata.title: Essentra Home White Marble Toothbrush Holder and Bathroom Organizer – Keeps Your Bathroom Counter Organized and in Style.
features: Organize in Style - Sick of countertop clutter? Our marble toothbrush holder is a beautiful and functional addition to your decor! Keep your toothbrush, lotion, soap and other essentials within easy reach with this chic little organizer.

Elegant Marble Design - Made of high-quality resin mixed with marble sand for a polished appearance and cool to the touch like stone, it's heavy enough to not tip over. Drain holes in each compartment keep the bathroom vanity organizer dry and rubber feet prevent scratches.

The Perfect Size - Our bathroom organizer measures 6.5 x 5.37 x 4.5 inches and is compact for small bathroom countertops yet big enough to hold your essential toiletries. Plus it's super easy to clean!

Multipurpose Organizer - Unlike cheap, plastic organizers, our marble organizer makes a functional and stylish addition to any bathroom decor or home office! Sturdy enough to hold toiletries or office supplies without taking up too much space.

This isn’t a cheap plastic organizer it is made of resin mixed with marble sand which adds considerable weight to the product and gives it a real stone like feel. It will not tip over easily and has a premium feel.

Modern Luxury Decor - At Essentra Home we make beautiful, practical and high- quality products at an affordable price! Storage shouldn't be ugly which is why we came up with this bathroom organizer to add beauty and function to your everyday life.
